topic: Trojan Horse: would you open the gates? (myth, Aeneid book 2)

beats.text: Troy, after ten years of war. You wake up, and the Greek army is gone.

scene.src: commons:Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo - The Procession of the Trojan Horse in Troy - WGA22382.jpg

beats.text: They left one thing on the beach: a giant wooden horse.
Before night, Troy must decide: bring it inside, or burn it.
Warning one: the priest Laocoön strikes it with a spear. Sea serpents kill him.

scene.src: commons:Apollonio di Giovanni, Tod des Laokoon, Deckfarbenminiatur Florenz Riccardiana Cod. 492 fol. 78 v.png

beats.text: Warning two: Cassandra screams it's a trap. Nobody ever believes her.
You pull it in. At night, Greek soldiers climb out and open the gates.

scene.src: commons:Frederik van Valckenborch - The Trojans celebrate the arrival of the wooden horse in the city.jpg

beats.text: Would YOU survive? Type SURVIVE or DEAD.
